svg.aria-label: llms.txt personal site. A forkable template for a personal website whose main reader is an AI assistant. Write Markdown, keep repeated facts in one JSON config, and build static HTML, an llms.txt index and JSON-LD. Shown as one glowing source feeding three pages while a reading lens sweeps across them.
